senses.gloss:
n. (-र्णं)
1 Dry ginger.
2 The emerald.
E.
सुपर्ण GARUḌA, and ठक् aff. of derivation.

m. (-यः)
GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU.
E.
सुपर्णा the mother of this being, and ढक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Connected with or relating to sleep, somnolent, somniferous, &c.
n. (-कं)
Nocturnal combat.
E.
सुप्त sleep, (or the hour of sleep,) and ठक् aff.
